note: DELIBERATELY BROKEN FIXTURE sign registry: far below the 80-sign floor, and the second entry has no MUTCD designation.

signs.name: STOP
signs.meaning: Come to a complete stop before the crosswalk or stop line; if you cannot see, edge forward to where you can and go only when it is safe.

citation.quote: you must bring your car to a complete stop, not going beyond the crosswalk

signs.name: YIELD
signs.meaning: Slow down and enter the intersection with caution; stop and wait when vehicles are approaching on the other roadway.

citation.quote: If you are sure no other cars are coming you need not come to a complete stop but you must slow down and enter the intersection with caution.
